svg.title: Inherited material precedes administrator access
svg.desc: Put cache recovery before the newly opened administrator gate. The archive mediates inheritance without making the later population the original artifacts' author. Visual distinction: Nested privilege layers and a keyhole distinguish authority from network reach. Open leaves indicate access established in the attributed account.
